node.title: Support-wise transverse LineRay rank charge
node.statement: For a selected LineRay error e_z=u+zv-p_z with zero mask S_z, support-wise nontriviality on that same S_z is equivalent to the pointwise transversality condition {Hu,Hv} not subset H(F^supp(e_z)). Hence the all-LineRay selector inequality applies to the entire support-mismatch population even if the received pair has a joint explanation on another support: #slopes<=C(sigma+n-A,sigma). Exact official-row arithmetic pays sigma<=3 from an 8n^3 half-reserve everywhere and also sigma=4 from P-A2's full combined 16n^3 reserve at RowC rate 1/4. A P-A2 counterexample therefore has minimum selector rank at least 5 there and at least 4 on the other five rows.
